title: container-agent configuration, format 1
description: agent.toml in /etc/container-agent: the modules of a container and their values.

puid.description: UID of the agent user; PUID in the environment wins.

pgid.description: GID of the agent user; PGID in the environment wins.

workspace.description: Working directory of agents and daemons.

auto_update.description: Upgrade tools tracked as latest on every start.

catalog.description: URL (or absolute path) of the catalog modules are downloaded from.

modules.description: Enabled modules: a catalog version, "latest", or "local" for modules/<name>.toml.

env.description: Values of module variables, not for secrets. The container environment wins.
